nodes.label: ADR 0175: Back from the background, the room and the sessions are made again at once
nodes.rationale: A phone freezes its sockets in the background and nothing reacted to coming back, so a song waited on a dead session. After more than 10 s away the room reconnects at once, sessions are made again, and a handshake waits up to 8 s for the room. Plain HTTPS from outside was rejected for now (needs a router port and certificates).
